-- AlterTable
ALTER TABLE "Campaign" ADD COLUMN     "approvedRecipientCount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
ADD COLUMN     "usesCustomRole" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
ADD COLUMN     "usesRepeatSend" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false;

-- CreateTable
CREATE TABLE "AccountNotice" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "userId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "deduplicationKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "campaignIdSnapshot" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "reasonCode" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "cancelledCount" INTEGER NOT NULL,
    "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "dismissedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),

    CONSTRAINT "AccountNotice_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

-- CreateTable
CREATE TABLE "AccountDeletionJob" (
    "id" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "userId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "googleSubjectHash" TEXT,
    "requestedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
    "credentialExpiresAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,
    "encryptedRevocationToken" TEXT,
    "googleRevokedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
    "credentialErasedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
    "googleRevocationIncomplete" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    "contentDeletedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
    "storageDeletedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
    "billingCancelledAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
    "completedAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
    "customerIds" TEXT[] DEFAULT ARRAY[]::TEXT[],
    "subscriptionIds" TEXT[] DEFAULT ARRAY[]::TEXT[],
    "checkoutRecovery" JSONB NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
    "billingRequired" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    "billingRecoveryVersion" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "cancellationAttempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "cancellationFailures" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "nextBillingAttemptAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "nextAttemptAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "leaseToken" TEXT,
    "leaseExpiresAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
    "failureCode" TEXT,
    "purgeFailureCode" TEXT,
    "alertPending" BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false,
    "alertAttempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    "nextAlertAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "lastAlertAt" TIMESTAMP(3),
    "alertFailureCode" TEXT,
    "createdAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
    "updatedAt" TIMESTAMP(3) NOT NULL,

    CONSTRAINT "AccountDeletionJob_pkey" PRIMARY KEY ("id")
);

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "AccountNotice_userId_dismissedAt_createdAt_idx" ON "AccountNotice"("userId", "dismissedAt", "createdAt");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "AccountNotice_userId_deduplicationKey_key" ON "AccountNotice"("userId", "deduplicationKey");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "AccountDeletionJob_userId_key" ON "AccountDeletionJob"("userId");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX "AccountDeletionJob_googleSubjectHash_key" ON "AccountDeletionJob"("googleSubjectHash");

-- CreateIndex
CREATE INDEX "AccountDeletionJob_completedAt_nextAttemptAt_id_idx" ON "AccountDeletionJob"("completedAt", "nextAttemptAt", "id");

-- AddForeignKey
ALTER TABLE "AccountNotice" ADD CONSTRAINT "AccountNotice_userId_fkey" FOREIGN KEY ("userId") REFERENCES "User"("id") ON DELETE CASCADE ON UPDATE CASCADE;


-- Preserve original approval even when history is later removed.
UPDATE "Campaign" c SET "approvedRecipientCount" = (SELECT count(*) FROM "Send" s WHERE s."campaignId"=c.id),
"usesCustomRole" = EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Send" s WHERE s."campaignId"=c.id AND s."recipientRole" NOT IN ('Software Engineer Intern','Frontend Developer','Backend Developer','Full Stack Developer','Software Engineer'));
